text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain will not take part in any meeting to be held in Qatar, foreign minister says.
Bahrain and Qatar are locked in a dispute over barren but potentilly rich Gulf islands.
- Prime minister opens commercial complex built at a cost of 11 million dinars.
- Japanese company to open a regional office in Bahrain.
- Around three million shares were traded on the Bahrain Stock Exchange on Wednesday in 67 transactions.
